scenes.headline: YOUR NEXT IDEA IS ALREADY IN ORBIT
scenes.narration: Your next big idea is already hiding in your notes.
scenes.visual_prompt: Kinetic 3D website slab slam with the Orbit Notes brand.

scenes.headline: SCATTERED THOUGHTS GET LOST
scenes.narration: Most notes apps store words. Orbit reconnects the thinking between them, so the idea you forgot comes back when it matters.
scenes.visual_prompt: Constellation of connected ideas resolving from scattered notes.

scenes.headline: LOCAL FIRST. LINKED BY DESIGN.
scenes.narration: The constellation view maps every link on your device. Offline search, open exports, and private sync keep deep work fast and portable.
scenes.visual_prompt: Real Orbit Notes interface with glowing graph connections and privacy callouts.

scenes.headline: THINK IN PUBLIC. KEEP IT YOURS.
scenes.narration: Seven minutes every Monday is enough to see what moved. Orbit Notes. Think in public, while keeping your thinking yours.
scenes.visual_prompt: Monday review card resolving into the Orbit Notes cover thumbnail.
